overview: The committee reviewed community feedback and public safety input regarding six high school design options. They voted to eliminate several alternatives before selecting Option C2.2A as the preferred schematic design to advance to the state.

items.title: Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the June 1st meeting with corrections to name spellings.

items.title: April and May Invoices
items.summary: Approved six invoices for April and May 2026 totaling $294,613 for project management and architectural services.

items.title: Evaluation Matrix Review
items.summary: Reviewed the scoring criteria and rankings for the six final design options, with some members expressing concerns regarding the equal weighting of disparate criteria like cost and tree canopy.

items.title: Community Feedback Summary
items.summary: Reviewed tabulated data from community meetings and online voting which showed a preference for the C2.2A and C3.4A design options.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: Residents expressed preferences for options that preserve community spaces like the pool and gym while voicing concerns about tax impacts and the location of community programs.

items.title: Review of Design Options
items.summary: The project team presented detailed summaries, timelines, and projected local costs for the six remaining design alternatives.

items.title: Public Safety Input
items.summary: Relayed feedback from the Police and Fire Chiefs, who advised against building on the front parking lot due to sightline issues and preferred the site circulation of the C2.2 designs.

items.title: Elimination of Option 8.1
items.summary: Approved a motion to eliminate the code-upgrade option because it fails to meet the educational plan and would receive no state reimbursement.

items.title: Elimination of Option D1.1
items.summary: Approved a motion to eliminate the new construction option on the parking lot based on safety concerns raised by the Police Chief.

items.title: Selection of Preferred Schematic Design
items.summary: Approved Option C2.2A as the preferred schematic design because it offers the most flexible and cost-effective layout while preserving existing athletic facilities and following the educational plan.

items.title: Meeting Schedule and Housekeeping
items.summary: Announced the next meeting for June 18th at the McGlynn School to sign the final report for submission.
